displayMaskReview.method: Single-agent spatial self-review of pinned source ways against immutable national mainland/island parts; source-mask-review.png inspected. No official/survey or independent review claimed.
displayMaskReview.policy: Keep exact source channel linework between the existing banks/land parts. Do not treat river water as maritime. Use exact source-way corridors only for individually recorded IDs; all other source geometry intersects the immutable display context. No inferred connector, polygon fill, coastal buffer or river coordinates.
